gui.packingcube.equipment_controls: Click to equip / unequip; Shift-click to return to inventory
gui.packingcube.ghost_help: Sample slot: left-click to copy the cursor item, right-click to clear. No physical items are stored.
gui.packingcube.no_exclude_rules: No exclude rules: all otherwise eligible items can be inserted.
gui.packingcube.no_rules: No include rules: nothing can be inserted.
gui.packingcube.no_tags: No tag candidates. Select a sample.
gui.packingcube.pickup_pouch_help: When ON, this installed pouch automatically stores matching ground items. OFF disables only this pouch. Manual insertion still follows the filter. Loose pouches do not auto-pick up. Open backpacks are temporarily skipped.
gui.packingcube.pickup_priority_help: 0-9: higher first across all backpacks. Ties: equipped backpack, inventory order, then left to right. Full pouches pass the remainder on.
gui.packingcube.refill_amount_custom: Fill hand to a chosen count
gui.packingcube.refill_amount_full: Fill hand to one full stack
gui.packingcube.refill_amount_help: Final hand count, not extra items.
gui.packingcube.refill_creative_help: No hand refill in Creative. Test in Survival.
gui.packingcube.refill_empty_exclude: No rules: all stored items may be supplied.
gui.packingcube.refill_empty_include: No rules: nothing may be supplied (when enabled).
gui.packingcube.refill_empty_pending: Slot selection is saved. Empty-slot item assignment and expanded refill are not enabled yet.
gui.packingcube.refill_filter_help: Limits only which items may be supplied. Storage is unrestricted. OFF keeps your rules.
gui.packingcube.refill_priority_help: 0-9: higher first. Ties: equipped backpack, inventory order, then left to right. Shortages continue to the next refill pouch.
gui.packingcube.refill_select_hint: Select inventory, equipment or Curios slots directly.
gui.packingcube.refill_setup_help: Stock and install in a backpack. Refills only the hand you use.
gui.packingcube.refill_shared_help: Shared by the whole pouch: refill filter and trading. Per-source ON/OFF also applies to trade supply.
gui.packingcube.refill_slot_rules_help: Each source holds one destination. Assigning a source switches this pouch from legacy hand refill to source rules.
gui.packingcube.refill_source_amount_hel: This source only. Amount means final destination count, not quantity added. Empty destinations fill automatically, including before first use.
gui.packingcube.refill_source_priority_h: Higher priority first. Ties: pouch order, then source 1–9. Other items return to free inventory space; otherwise replacement is skipped.
gui.packingcube.refill_status_creative: Hand refill is disabled in Creative. Test in Survival.
gui.packingcube.refill_status_cursor: Put down the item on the cursor.
gui.packingcube.refill_status_empty: Hold the item to check. Empty slots are only refilled immediately after consumption.
gui.packingcube.refill_status_filter: Matching stock is blocked by the refill filter.
gui.packingcube.refill_status_mapped: Source-slot mode: check the pouch's 1-9 pages for destination, stock, enabled state and amount.
gui.packingcube.refill_status_menu: Close the container screen before testing hand use.
gui.packingcube.refill_status_pouch: No installed refill pouch enables this hand/slot. Check the backpack, switches and slot selection.
gui.packingcube.refill_status_stock: No stock matches this item and all its components.
gui.packingcube.refill_status_use: Matching stock found. Refill occurs only after use meets the chosen condition, not by moving items.
gui.packingcube.refill_threshold_label: Refill when hand count is at most:
gui.packingcube.refill_timing_empty: Refill when the hand is empty
gui.packingcube.refill_timing_threshold: Refill at the chosen remaining count
gui.packingcube.refill_trade_help: One payment at a time. Trading stays manual.
gui.packingcube.rules_help: Shows the current mode. Click to switch Include/Exclude without clearing rules. Manual insertion is filtered too.
gui.packingcube.sample_help: Hold an item and click the sample slot. Nothing is consumed. Right-click to clear.
gui.packingcube.settings_space_help: Not enough room beside the inventory. Reduce GUI Scale or widen the window to open settings.
gui.packingcube.stow_all_help: Move items from the 27 main inventory slots into this backpack's pouches. Uses filters and priority, even with auto pickup OFF. Hotbar and equipment stay put; leftovers remain in their original slots. Requires an empty cursor.
message.packingcube.close_menu: Close the bag screen before editing filters.
message.packingcube.empty_cursor: Put down the cursor stack before switching screens.
message.packingcube.filter_cleared: Filter reset to include mode with no rules. Stored items were not changed.
message.packingcube.filter_limit: A filter supports up to %s rules in total.
message.packingcube.hold_filter: Hold a Storage Pouch in your main hand.
message.packingcube.legacy_overflow: Recovered %s items from the old bag slots. %s items are still retained; free inventory space and reopen the bag.
tooltip.packingcube.filter_more: %s more (view all rules in the bag filter screen)
tooltip.packingcube.refill_supply: Supplies only from this pouch while installed in a backpack.
tooltip.packingcube.refill_trade_note: Fills the selected trade's payments; trading remains manual.
